verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes API endpoints, CLI authorization, and an MCP server granting 'secure read and write access' to CRM data, but never documents scoped or least-privilege credential issuance (e.g., configurable OAuth scopes, private-app token permission granularity) specifically for agent use. Missing for 10: documentation of scope selection/least-privilege token creation, evidence of per-agent permission restriction, and any independent confirmation that agents can be limited to narrow scopes.
